messages.content: List 3 peer-reviewed research papers about how Parents Weekend visits affect college students' grades. Include the authors, year, journal and DOI.

response.text:
1. Author: Pascarella, E. T., & Terenzini, P. T.
Year: 1991
Title: How college affects students: Findings and insights from twenty years of research
Journal: Jossey-Bass
DOI: N/A

2. Author: Kim, Y. K., & Sax, L. J.
Year: 2009
Title: The effects of student-faculty interaction on academic self-concept: Does academic major matter?
Journal: Research in Higher Education
DOI: 10.1007/s11162-009-9130-2

3. Author: Pascarella, E. T., & Terenzini, P. T.
Year: 2005
Title: How college affects students: A third decade of research
Journal: Jossey-Bass
DOI: N/A
